liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (5 reviews): Bertha called the best the band played after Brent died; Vince's piano and Jerry's uptempo solo stand out; Bertha is called one of the best heard in the later years; Loose Lucy also nice [8][10][11][12][13]
- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Reviewer reached seats as Help on the Way began; the show was on from there; Highlights include a well executed Help>Slip>Franklin's and a solid Terrapin [7][14]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Terrapin is described as great, with an especially interesting section; Terrapin and Wharf Rat gave the reviewer goosebumps; Jerry's guitar cut through [10][15]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Jerry belts out the vocals in Franklin's Tower [8]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Loose Lucy and Bertha were smokin' [6]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Wharf Rat in the post-space segment is called incredible; reviewer's favorite part of the show [12]
- **Around And Around** (1 review): Around and Around was long, a change from the reelin' and rockin' early-80s versions [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-06-09.150588.sbd.miller.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 154 min [1]
- **gd93-06-09.sbd.miller.13601.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds really good [11]
- **gd1993-06-09.sennME80.wklitz.94350.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1993-06-09.sbd.unknown.9457.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Very hot, sticky day at the Palace; the writer sold imports on Shakedown Street in the parking lot and attended both nights [6]
- Reviewer felt the band played to the weather, keeping the crowd sweating, with no chance of cooling off [6]
- Reviewer lived near the Palace, skipped work, and got fifth-row center tickets at the box office for face value [7]
- Reviewer had attended the previous night, found it mellow, and wanted more, so came back with a friend, Adam [7]
- Reviewer attended aged 8 with parents; the Deadheads in the parking lot made the night unique [9]
- Reviewer says the parking lot scene got more praise than the music; they enjoyed themselves but weren't impressed by the show [13]
- Reviewer attended both Palace nights, first time seeing the band since Brent's death, while in graduate school [14]
- Reviewer recalls purple shields and a colorful, kaleidoscopic visual spectacle during the show [15]
- The previous night's Birdsong is said to be one of the best of the 1990s [8]
- Easy Answers is the weak point of the first set, which otherwise hits its stride from Franklin's on [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-06-09.150588.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 20, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) [1]
- **gd93-06-09.sbd.miller.13601.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>Dat>Cm>Dat>Samplitude>CD [3]. Also: Soundboard to DAT, to cassette, to DAT, then Samplitude and CD; seeded to etree by Charlie Miller [3]
- **gd1993-06-09.sennME80.wklitz.94350.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Sennheiser ME-80's > Technics SVM-D1 [2]
- **gd1993-06-09.sbd.unknown.9457.shnf**: transferred by unknown; source: S>D>C>D>CD [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Palace - June 9, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-9-1993) [19]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1993-06-09 Wed The Palace, Auburn Hills, MI](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1271700096054/grateful-dead-1993-06-09-wed-the-palace) [20]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1993-06-09 Wed The Palace, Auburn Hills, MI](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1271700096054/grateful-dead-1993-06-09-wed-the-palace) [21]
